tenant_isolation.finding: /api/mssp/tenants/{tenant_id}/feed does not verify the caller is authorized for the requested tenant_id -- it only checks tier (Enterprise/MSSP), then uses tenant_id purely as a response label/filter context. Lower severity than classic BOLA because this codebase has no per-tenant private data store today (the underlying feed is the same shared global data for every tenant_id string) -- but the endpoint's own documentation and response field ('Tenant-scoped threat feed') overstate isolation that does not exist. See docs/ENTITLEMENT_RESOURCE_INVENTORY_V185.md Section 5. Not fixed this pass: the real fix is a product/architecture decision (correct the claim, or build real per-tenant storage), out of scope for this certification pass.
